_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular manifest fragment — never edit src/manifest.json
_meta.description: The invoice layout pages (REQ-SID-001, task 4.1): an index of the layouts, one per administration, and a detail page that edits the logo, the primary and accent colours, the variant, the footer and the QR switch, with a Preview sidebar tab (InvoiceLayoutPreview) that draws a sample invoice page in those colours and writes out each colour's contrast against white. The server refuses a primary colour below 4.5:1 on save (InvoiceLayoutContrastListener). The menu leaf is lifted into the settings foldout by src/menu-layout.json.

config.description: How each administration's invoices look: logo, colours, layout variant, footer and the QR codes to pay.

config._note: One administration's invoice layout (REQ-SID-001). The body edits the layout's fields; the Preview tab shows a sample invoice page in the saved colours and variant with the contrast of each colour written out, and the audit trail records every change. A save with a primary colour below 4.5:1 against white is refused by the server with the ratio in the message.
